questions.q: What is the real, shipped mechanism behind multi-turn 'agent memory' in Cortex Agents?
options: Threads — server-side storage of conversation context across turns
A separate long-term memory database the user must configure
A browser cookie stored on the client's device
There is no mechanism; each request is fully independent
questions.explain: Threads maintain conversation context across turns server-side inside Snowflake — that is the concrete feature behind the word 'memory' here.

questions.q: What does parent_message_id equal for the very first message in a new thread?
questions.explain: parent_message_id is 0 for the first message in a thread, and the ID of the last successful assistant message for every subsequent turn.

questions.q: What problem does using a thread's server-side history solve for a client application?
options: It avoids having to resend the entire prior conversation transcript with every new request
It eliminates the need for any user authentication
It removes the need for a semantic model in Cortex Analyst
It automatically translates the conversation into other languages
questions.explain: Because Snowflake restores history server-side, a follow-up request only needs the new message and the thread_id, not the full prior transcript.

questions.q: According to this lesson, what is a thread NOT the same thing as?
options: Long-term, cross-conversation personalization of a user's preferences
A mechanism for maintaining context within one conversation
A feature that uses thread_id and parent_message_id
questions.explain: The lesson is explicit: a thread solves 'remember this conversation,' not 'remember this person forever' — true cross-session personalization requires a separate design, like a stored user profile.

questions.q: Besides avoiding resent transcripts, what additional capability does the parent_message_id chain enable, per this lesson?
options: Forking a conversation or recovering cleanly from a failed response by pointing a new message at an earlier, known-good message
Automatically deleting old threads after 24 hours
Converting the thread into a Cortex Search service
Bypassing RBAC for the duration of the thread
questions.explain: Because parent_message_id references a specific prior message rather than always 'the latest,' an application can branch or recover by pointing at a different known-good message.
